title: NVIDIA Announces New Planned Investments in Korean Startups at the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum

claims.claim: Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT and NVIDIA hosted the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum at COEX.

evidence.quote: Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT and NVIDIA hosted the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum at COEX.

claims.claim: Ryu Je-myung, vice minister of science and ICT, met with over 20 Korean startups across foundation models, physical AI, AI infrastructure and AI semiconductors.

evidence.quote: Ryu Je-myung, vice minister of science and ICT, joined NVIDIA leaders to meet with over 20 Korean startups across foundation models, physical AI, AI infrastructure and AI semiconductors.

claims.claim: NVIDIA announced an investment in Korean startup Point2, with additional investments planned in Motif Technologies, RLWRLD and Upstage.

evidence.quote: NVIDIA also announced an investment in Korean startup Point2, with additional investments planned in Motif Technologies, RLWRLD and Upstage.

claims.claim: Point2 Technology is an AI interconnect company that builds scalable, radio frequency-based interconnects between chips and racks in AI factories.

evidence.quote: Point2 Technology, an AI interconnect company, builds scalable, radio frequency-based interconnects that move data between chips and racks in AI factories

claims.claim: Motif Technologies is a Seoul-based AI lab that develops foundation models for building AI agents, including the open-weights large language model Motif-3.

evidence.quote: Motif Technologies, a Seoul-based AI lab, develops foundation models for building AI agents that carry out complex tasks, including Motif-3, a large language model released with open weights.

claims.claim: RLWRLD is a physical AI startup based in San Francisco, Seoul and Tokyo that develops robotics foundation models for humanoid and industrial robots.

evidence.quote: RLWRLD, a physical AI startup based in San Francisco, Seoul and Tokyo, develops robotics foundation models that enable humanoid and industrial robots to perform complex real-world tasks

claims.claim: Upstage is a Korean enterprise AI company that develops Solar language models and document AI tools for businesses.

evidence.quote: Upstage, a Korean enterprise AI company, develops Solar language models and document AI tools that help businesses extract information from complex documents, streamline workflows and build AI applications for everyday operations.

claims.claim: More than 1,000 Korea-based members participate in NVIDIA Inception, a program helping startups grow with technical expertise and investor introductions.

evidence.quote: including more than 1,000 Korea-based members of NVIDIA Inception, a program that helps startups grow with access to preferred pricing, technical expertise and opportunities for investor introductions.
